notes:
NuVo via RS-232: choosing it on the Sources page now searches every COM port for the NuVo bridge and selects the port and speed it answers on. The serial ports are reserved for the bridge, the port can also be chosen by hand, and the page shows whether the bridge is communicating.
Attero Tech MatchBox USB: the Sources page now offers its four stereo outputs the first time the card is found, without the MCS Configurator.
Firmware page: shows the date the installed release expires. The server log and window titles show the MPS4 Fenix release number.
Auxiliary page: MCS sources are listed with the same names as on the Sources page.
